title: CONTROLLING DIRECTIONS ORTHOGONAL TO A CLASSIFIER
reasoning: The paper presents a technical machine learning approach for 'classifier orthogonalization' to improve style transfer, domain adaptation, and fairness. While it addresses algorithmic fairness (e.g., gender/age bias in predictions), it does so via mathematical constraints and technical metrics on image and tabular data, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical systems.
